outcomes: If an unpublished request row is selected, send its payload to weather.place-requested and then mark that outbox row published in the database transaction.
If no unpublished row is available, the publish operation returns without sending a message.
Other observed failures are logged for retry; the source alone does not establish that the hosted service is activated at runtime.
process.scope: RequestPublisher.ExecuteAsync and its source-level outbox publishing operation.
process.trigger: ExecuteAsync receives a cancellation token and enters its publisher loop.

summary: Source-level process for RequestPublisher.ExecuteAsync and its PublishPending helper in the Places service.
title: Publish pending place requests
